maintenance_led.reason: Majority of revenue is recurring commercial landscape maintenance contracts on existing properties; smaller development segment does new installs.

publicly_funded.reason: Customers are private commercial property owners, HOAs, corporate campuses, retail and healthcare sites, not mainly government.

serial_acquirer.reason: Grows mainly organically through contract wins and renewals, with tuck-in acquisitions as a supplement rather than the main growth path.

mission_critical.reason: Landscape maintenance is a largely commoditized, competitively bid service; customers can switch providers with modest disruption.
